description_en: Some quotas are dependent on others and must be increased together. This operation lists the quotas that a specified quota depends on
description_zh: 部分配额之间存在关联，关联配额最好同时提升，该接口返回某个配额关联的配额项列表
kebab_example: aliyun quotas list-dependent-quotas --product-code cloudsso --quota-action-code q_system-policy-per-access-configuration --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDependentQuotas
